operation_details.item: The user must not work on engagements involving competitors or related parties without conflict disclosure and firm clearance procedures.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I have a potential new client that operates in the same industry as one of my existing clients. I'm not sure how to proceed.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a potential conflict of interest. What does your firm's policy say about working with competitors?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I recall that there is a strict policy. I must not be advised to work on engagements involving competitors or related parties without disclosing potential conflicts of interest and following my firm's conflict-check and clearance procedures.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: You are absolutely correct. The first step is to disclose this potential conflict to your firm's compliance or ethics team immediately. They will guide you through the conflict-check process, and you should not proceed with the engagement until you receive formal clearance.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So I should not take on the project until I get clearance?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. Even if you believe there is no actual conflict, it is essential to follow the proper procedures to protect both your client and your firm.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. I'll contact the compliance team today.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That is the best course of action. They will advise on the next steps, which may include obtaining waivers or declining the engagement.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thank you for the advice. I'll make sure to document everything as well.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: You're welcome. Proper documentation is also important for your records.
